_about: Public-domain John Cordner (1816-1894), Irish-born minister of the Unitarian Church of the Messiah, Montreal, for the Word Hoard: his sermons and lectures: Jesus (a Christmas sermon), Christ the Son of God (a reply to Henry Wilkes), The Philosophic Origin and Historic Progress of the Doctrine of the Trinity, a pastoral letter, The Foundations of Nationality, The Christian Idea of Sacrifice, Righteousness Exalteth a Nation, Twenty-five Sermons (1868) and Is Protestantism a Failure? (1869). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 91 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

cordner-jesus-christmas: Jesus : a Christmas sermon preached in the Unitarian Church, Montreal, Christmas day, 1851 (Montreal : John C. Becket, 1851)
cordner-christ-son-of-god: Christ, the Son of God. A discourse in review of the Rev. Dr. Wilkes' sermon, entitle "Who is Chirst?" (Montreal : James Potts, Herald Office, 1851)
cordner-trinity: Philosophic origin and historic progress of the Doctrine of the Trinity : a lecture, delivered in the Unitarian Church Montreal, on Sunday Evening, January 26th, 1851 (Montreal : John C. Becket, 1851)
cordner-pastoral-letter: A pastoral letter to the Christian congregation assembling for worship and edification in the Unitarian Church, Montreal ([Montréal? : s.n.], 1853)
cordner-nationality: The foundations of nationality, a discourse, preached in the Unitarian Church, Montreal, on the Sunday after the great railway celebration, November, 1856 (Montreal : Henry Rose, 1856)
cordner-sacrifice: The Christian idea of sacrifice : a discourse preached at the dedication of the Church of the Messiah, Montreal, on Sunday, 12th September, 1858 / by Rev. John Cordner (Montreal : Henry Rose, 1858)
cordner-righteousness: Righteousness exalteth a nation; a discourse concerning the relation of morality to national wellbeing (Montreal, Rose, 1860)
cordner-twenty-five-sermons: Twenty-five sermons : a memorial of twenty-five years' ministry (Montreal : Printed by J. Lovell, 1868)
cordner-protestantism-failure: Is Protestantism a failure? : the question considered in five lectures : also a discourse on Christian monotheism ([S.l. : s.n.], 1869)

_excluded.cordner-addresses: his civic orations before the New England Society of Montreal (The Vision of the Pilgrim Fathers, The American Conflict, Canada and the United States)
